rule: Every admitted morphism requires typed domain, codomain, formula, well-definedness, preserved structure, fibres or kernel, inverse status, exceptions, proof locator, and dependencies.

name: survivor_odd_2_adic_first_return_self_map
domain: D=(1+2Z_2)\E, where E is the full eventual backward orbit of x_*=-1/3 under the defined partial accelerated branches.
codomain: The same survivor space D.
well_definedness: For x in D, x is not x_*, so the valuation is a finite positive integer and the quotient is odd. If C_2(x) were in E_n, then x would be in E_(n+1), contradicting x in D.
preserved_structure: Odd 2-adic integrality, avoidance of the eventual singular orbit, the forward dynamics, and—under epsilon_2—the left-shift action.
fibres: For every y in D, C_2^(-1)(y)={(2^a y-1)/3:a>=1}. Every displayed point is odd 2-adic, has exact valuation a, and lies in D; hence every fibre is countably infinite with its exponent label explicit.
inverse_status: There is no single inverse. Each h_a(y)=(2^a y-1)/3 is an injective branch section satisfying C_2 h_a=id_D, and the branch images are disjoint by exact valuation.
exceptions: The partial map on all odd 2-adics is undefined at -1/3.
An infinite forward itinerary requires removal of all eventual preimages E, not only -1/3.
Positive integer dynamics is a proper invariant subset and is not identified with D.

name: finite_word_inverse_branch_affine_homeomorphism
domain: For a fixed finite positive exponent word w, the odd 2-adic space O_2=1+2Z_2.
codomain: The exact prefix ball U_w=r_w+2^(A(w)+1)Z_2.
formula: h_w(y)=(2^A(w)y-B_w)/3^|w|, equivalently h_(a_1) composed through h_(a_n) with h_a(y)=(2^a y-1)/3.
well_definedness: The denominator 3^|w| is a 2-adic unit. Direct substitution gives the unique odd 2-adic initial point whose first |w| exact valuations are w and whose terminal value is y.
preserved_structure: 2-adic topology, the exact finite valuation word, affine coordinates, and the nested residue-class structure under word extension.
fibres: For each x in U_w, h_w^(-1)({x})={C_2^|w|(x)}. Equivalently, every codomain point has exactly one preimage in O_2 under h_w.
inverse_status: This is a homeomorphism with two-sided inverse C_2^|w| restricted to U_w. The terminated boundary point is h_w(-1/3), and removing all such eventual boundary points restricts the map to survivor cylinders.
exceptions: U_w contains h_w(-1/3) and later exceptional points, so it is not wholly contained in D.
The map is word-typed; erasing w loses the chosen inverse branch.

name: survivor_itinerary_homeomorphic_conjugacy
domain: The survivor space D=(1+2Z_2)\E with the subspace 2-adic topology and self-map C_2.
codomain: The full one-sided countable shift N_(>0)^(N_0) with the product topology and left shift sigma.
well_definedness: D excludes exactly every point reaching the zero numerator. Exact finite prefix balls are nested and shrink to one point for every infinite word, and the resulting point cannot be exceptional because every next prescribed valuation is finite.
preserved_structure: Topology, finite cylinders, chronological exponent labels, and dynamics: epsilon_2 C_2=sigma epsilon_2.
fibres: Every fibre is a singleton. The fibre of a word a is the unique intersection of its balls r_(a|n)+2^(A_n+1)Z_2.
inverse_status: The nested-ball map is a two-sided continuous inverse. It is not an integer-valued inverse: all but countably many full-shift words correspond to nonrational 2-adic points, while the positive-integer image is the countable dense proper subset Sigma_C^+.
exceptions: There is no itinerary morphism on the exceptional set E.
Restricting the domain to positive odds changes the image to the countable dense proper subset Sigma_C^+.
The conjugacy proves no positive-orbit endpoint theorem.

name: canonical_prefix_word_state_embedding
domain: The rooted free monoid tree N_(>0)^* of finite positive exponent words, including the empty root.
codomain: The canonical state set S_can={(A(w)+1,r_w):w in N_(>0)^*}, with edges induced by word extension.
formula: kappa_can(w)=(A(w)+1,r_w), where r_w is the least positive odd solution of 3^|w|r+B_w=2^A modulo 2^(A+1).
well_definedness: The finite-prefix theorem gives a unique r_w. If two words have the same pair, any positive representative realizes both; deterministic itineraries make one a prefix of the other, and equal total exponent forces equal length and equality.
preserved_structure: Root, word-extension edges after transporting the edge relation, total exponent precision, canonical residue nesting, and the positive-end stabilization selector.
fibres: Every fibre is a singleton. For an admitted pair, recover its word by reading the exact finite itinerary of any positive representative until its cumulative exponent is N-1.
inverse_status: It is a bijection onto the declared canonical state set. The printed congruence 3r'+1=2^a r is not the transported successor; the correct successor decodes w and computes r_(wa).
exceptions: The target is the canonical state subset, not every odd pair (N,r).
The root-based ray set and the full edge shift of the countable graph are different dynamical objects.
No impossibility statement for other encodings is claimed.

name: composable_path_bidegree_functor
domain: The positive-odd first-return path category E_C.
codomain: The one-object category B N_0^2 with endomorphism monoid (N_0^2,+).
formula: deg(p)=(ell(p),A(p)-ell(p)); every object maps to the unique object.
well_definedness: Length and total exponent are additive under composable concatenation, and every identity maps to (0,0), so the functor axioms hold.
preserved_structure: Identities, composable path concatenation, length, odd-step count, and intervening even-step count.
fibres: For (r,s) with r>=1, the exponent-word component contains binomial(r+s-1,r-1) positive compositions of r+s into r parts; every such word has one infinite positive source class modulo 2^(r+s+1). Over (0,0) every object identity occurs, while every fibre over (0,s) with s>0 is empty.
inverse_status: There is no inverse: objects, exponent order, and arithmetic sources are deliberately erased. Retaining source-target matrix units gives the typed algebra representation of MOR-COL-000041 rather than an inverse to deg.
exceptions: The functor is defined on categorical composition, not on zero products of noncomposable basis elements in the category algebra.
Its degree cone is N_0^2 and is not identified with the full Connes-Consani Newton-polygon semiring.

name: translated_quadrant_Newton_polygon_embedding
domain: The additive monoid N_0^2.
codomain: The multiplicative monoid of the Connes-Consani semiring Conv(Z^2), whose multiplication is Minkowski sum.
well_definedness: Every translated quadrant (r,s)+Q is closed and convex, satisfies C+Q=C, obeys the literal source condition C subset (r,s)+Q, and has the unique integral extreme point (r,s). Since Q+Q=Q, Minkowski sum adds anchors: j(r,s)+_Mink j(r',s')=j(r+r',s+s').
preserved_structure: The additive monoid law, identity j(0,0)=Q, and the two lattice anchor coordinates.
fibres: Every translated upper quadrant in the image has the singleton anchor fibre {(r,s)}; every other element of Conv(Z^2) has empty fibre.
inverse_status: The inverse on the image reads the unique extreme anchor. There is no surjection or semiring isomorphism onto Conv(Z^2).
exceptions: This is a monoid embedding, not by itself an additive semiring map from the Collatz category algebra.
It supplies no Frobenius correspondence or arithmetic-site identification.

name: formal_affine_line_branch_endomorphism
domain: The bounded 3-adic formal affine line Ahat^1_(Z_3)=Spf(Z_3<T>).
codomain: The same bounded 3-adic formal affine line.
formula: Contravariantly on coordinates, fix Z_3 and send T to (3T+1)/2^a for a fixed a>=1.
well_definedness: The coefficient 2^(-a) lies in Z_3, and restricted-polynomial substitution is a continuous Z_3-algebra endomorphism of Z_3<T>.
preserved_structure: The Z_3-base, 3-adic continuity, the formal affine-line object, and the affine branch polynomial. Bhatt-Lurie functoriality can therefore be applied to this actual formal-scheme map.
fibres: On Z_3-valued points the map is injective with image 2^(-a)+3Z_3. A target y in that coset has the singleton fibre {(2^a y-1)/3}; targets outside it have empty fibre.
inverse_status: There is an inverse only from the image coset to Z_3-valued points, not a global formal-line automorphism because the slope 3/2^a is not a 3-adic unit.
exceptions: This is not a self-map of the base formal point Spf(Z_3).
For every a, the positive integer valuation-a stratum and its complement meet every finite 3-adic residue ball; no clopen subset of Z_3 restricts to that selector on positive odds.
The family does not assemble the piecewise Collatz map, a prismatic lift, or a crystalline comparison.

name: fixed_word_Collatz_Machin_unit_product_modulo_mu4
domain: The additive group Z^n for a fixed positive exponent word w of length n.
codomain: U_1(Q(i))/mu_4, where U_1(Q(i))={x in Q(i)^x:x conjugate(x)=1}.
formula: Gamma_bar_w(m)=[product_(k=1)^n u_k(w)^(m_k)], with u_k=(2^A_k+i3^(k-1))/(2^A_k-i3^(k-1)).
well_definedness: Each u_k is a nonzero norm-one element of Q(i); integer powers and multiplication define a homomorphism, and quotienting by mu_4 is compatible with multiplication.
preserved_structure: The additive law on exponent vectors, multiplication of unit products, the exact prefix angles, and rational-pi torsion modulo mu_4.
fibres: The kernel is exactly Rel_pi(w). Every nonempty fibre is a coset of Rel_pi(w); points outside the image have empty fibre.
inverse_status: The induced map Z^n/Rel_pi(w)->im(Gamma_bar_w) is an isomorphism with inverse sending an image point to its unique source coset.
exceptions: No surjectivity onto all U_1(Q(i))/mu_4 is claimed.
This fixed-word map alone does not give a uniform rank theorem.

name: oriented_split_Gaussian_prime_valuation_isomorphism
codomain: The finite-support direct sum over rational primes p congruent to 1 mod 4 of Z.
formula: After choosing one Gaussian prime varpi_p above each split p, nu_G([x])=(v_(varpi_p)(x))_p.
well_definedness: Unique factorization in Z[i] makes split-prime valuations finite. Norm one forces conjugate valuations to be opposite and kills inert and ramified valuations; changing x by a Gaussian unit changes none.
preserved_structure: Multiplication becomes coordinate addition, conjugation reverses all split-prime exponents, and finite support is preserved.
fibres: Every fibre is a singleton because the map is an isomorphism; its kernel is the identity class mu_4.
inverse_status: The exact inverse sends (e_p)_p to [product_p (varpi_p/conjugate(varpi_p))^(e_p)].
exceptions: Changing the chosen orientation over p negates only the p-coordinate.
The construction is a coordinate choice, not a canonical ordering of split primes.

name: fixed_word_signed_Gaussian_valuation_map
domain: The additive group Z^n for a fixed positive exponent word w.
codomain: The finite-support direct sum over rational primes p congruent to 1 mod 4 of Z.
formula: E_w=nu_G composed with Gamma_bar_w, with matrix entry (E_w)_(p,k)=v_(varpi_p)(z_k(w))-v_(conjugate(varpi_p))(z_k(w)).
well_definedness: Each column is the finite signed split-prime valuation vector of z_k/conjugate(z_k), so matrix multiplication agrees exactly with the composite homomorphism.
preserved_structure: Integer linear combinations, multiplication of the associated Gaussian unit products, all split-prime exponent differences, and the exact relation kernel.
fibres: The kernel is Rel_pi(w); each nonempty fibre is a coset, and fibres outside im(E_w) are empty.
inverse_status: The induced quotient map Z^n/Rel_pi(w)->im(E_w) has the exact inverse y->m+Rel_pi(w) for any m with E_w(m)=y.
exceptions: A fixed matrix is computable after factoring the finitely many norms, but no uniform factorization or rank bound is inferred.
Reorienting a split prime negates a row without changing the kernel.

name: Poisson_gamma_chi_square_upper_tail_coordinate
domain: D={(n,t): n in N_0 and t in [0,infinity)}
codomain: E={(n,p): n in N_0 and p in (0,1]}
formula: (n,t) maps to (n,F_n(t)), where F_n(t)=exp(-t)sum_(j=0)^n t^j/j!=Gamma(n+1,t)/Gamma(n+1)=Q(2t|2n+2)
well_definedness: Repeated integration by parts proves the finite-sum upper-incomplete-gamma identity for every retained n and t; A&S 26.4.21 with c=n+1, nu=2n+2, m=t and chi^2=2t gives the chi-square coordinate exactly.
preserved_structure: The integer stratum n and the numerical upper-tail value are retained; on each fixed-n stratum increasing t reverses order strictly, and the Poisson, normalized upper-gamma, and upper-chi-square presentations are equal without approximation.
fibres: Singletons in D because n is retained and F_n is strictly decreasing from 1 to 0 on [0,infinity); forgetting n destroys injectivity and is not part of the morphism.
inverse_status: For each retained n and p in (0,1], the inverse is the unique t=F_n^(-1)(p); existence follows from continuity and endpoint limits and uniqueness from strict decrease. No elementary inverse formula is asserted.
exceptions: The value p=0 has no finite-t preimage and is only a limit as t tends to infinity.
For n>0 the derivative vanishes at t=0, but the finite-sum identity and positive derivative magnitude for t>0 still give strict decrease on the whole stratum.
No injectivity is claimed after forgetting n.
The exact coordinate does not supply the moving-cutoff asymptotic by itself.
The controlling NBS first-printing facsimile is not Crandall's cited ninth Dover printing.

name: odd_first_return_time_change
domain: positive odd integers and finite C_Cr-orbit segments with accelerated indices j
codomain: the same states embedded in shortened T-time A_j and unshortened U-time A_j+j
formula: e_i=nu_2(3*C_Cr^i(x)+1), A_j=sum_(i<j)e_i, C_Cr^j(x)=T^(A_j)(x)=U^(A_j+j)(x)
well_definedness: each e_i is a finite positive integer on a positive odd state, so A_j is a finite strictly increasing integer clock
preserved_structure: every state and orbit order at successive odd returns, with exact elapsed shortened and unshortened times
fibres: on an admitted accelerated segment the time embeddings are injective because A_(j+1)>A_j and A_(j+1)+j+1>A_j+j
inverse_status: the accelerated index is recovered by restricting either whole-integer trajectory to its successive odd-return positions; elapsed times recover each e_i by successive differences
exceptions: variable-time embedding, not a fixed-iterate conjugacy

heights, periods, density thresholds, and historical bounds require explicit clock translation; the Conway-to-Crandall historical transfer is proved separately at Proposition prop:Conway-Crandall-historical-transfer
The Allouche and Korec thresholds are strict natural-density conclusions; the accelerated limiting exponent coordinate does not supply their density proofs or their endpoints.

name: run_lengths_to_parity_word
domain: (positive integers)^N_0
codomain: binary sequences beginning at one with infinitely many ones
formula: ones occur at partial sums s_j=sum_{i<j}a_i
well_definedness: positive gaps give strictly increasing unbounded one positions
preserved_structure: left run shift becomes binary shift by a_0 positions
fibres: singletons
inverse_status: successive differences of one positions

name: accelerated_exponent_to_shortened_parity_factorization
domain: positive odd integers
codomain: positive run sequences and infinite parity sequences
formula: P=B o E
well_definedness: every positive odd iterate has finite positive return exponent
preserved_structure: E(C_Cr x)=shift(E(x)); P(C_Cr x)=shift^{e(x)}(P(x))
fibres: E is injective
inverse_status: inverse exists only on the image E(Opos); no global positive-integer realization asserted

name: Bernstein_Lagarias_parity_conjugacy
domain: Z_2 under shortened T
codomain: Z_2 under binary digit shift S
formula: Q_3(x)=sum_i parity(T^i x)2^i; Q_3 o T=S o Q_3
well_definedness: 2-adic digit series converges and branch map is total on Z_2
preserved_structure: dynamics, all congruence distances, topology
fibres: singletons

name: purely_periodic_parity_word_to_return_point
domain: finite binary words with a retained displayed length L, repeated in Z_2
codomain: 2-adic periodic points of shortened T
well_definedness: 1-2^L and 2^L-3^m are odd 2-adic units
preserved_structure: least shift period equals least T-period
fibres: word phases represent corresponding cycle phases; displayed nonleast blocks retain return length but not least period
inverse_status: Q_3 recovers the purely periodic parity word from the point

name: generalized_residue_itinerary_conjugacy
domain: Z_d under the continuous extension of a Matthews residue-wise affine map with d>=2 and gcd(m_i,d)=1 for every branch
codomain: Z_d under the full d-adic digit shift S_d
formula: It_T(x)=sum_(j>=0) i_j(x)d^j, where T_hat^j(x)=i_j(x) mod d; It_T o T_hat=S_d o It_T
well_definedness: the digit series converges in Z_d; common inputs modulo d^alpha have the same first alpha itinerary digits
preserved_structure: all residue congruence levels, digit-prefix metric, topology, Haar cylinder measure, and dynamics
fibres: singletons; no group-theoretic kernel is applicable because additivity is not asserted
inverse_status: It_T^{-1}(sum i_j d^j)=sum_(j>=0) r_(i_j)d^j/(m_(i_0)...m_(i_j)); all denominators are d-adic units

formal_status.verified: literal one-digit lift, explicit unit affine inverse, ordinary-gcd range and attainable-fibre cardinalities
formal_status.open: arbitrary-depth compatibility, inverse limit, infinite series, homeomorphism and full conjugacy

exceptions: requires gcd(m_i,d)=1 for every branch for surjectivity and singleton fibres
if gcd(m_i,d)>1, some length-two cylinders beginning at i are missing and attained next digits have multiple lifts

name: fixed_modulus_Matthews_rcwa_presentation_crosswalk
domain: Matthews branch presentations (d;(m_i,r_i)) with retained d>=2, m_i nonzero, and r_i congruent to i*m_i modulo d
codomain: pairs of the retained d and a branchwise reduced rcwa coefficient list (a_i,b_i,c_i) at d with nonzero slopes
formula: forward: reduce (m_i,-r_i,d) by g_i=gcd(m_i,d)=gcd(m_i,r_i,d); reverse: m_i=a_i*d/c_i and r_i=-b_i*d/c_i
well_definedness: Matthews congruence is exactly integer-valuedness of the common-denominator branch; for primitive rcwa triples c_i divides d and a_i*i+b_i, while gcd(a_i,c_i)=1, so the reverse coefficients are integral and their common-denominator triples reduce back exactly
preserved_structure: the underlying pointwise function Z->Z, the retained residue-class partition, the chosen d, and the full Matthews branch data
fibres: singletons in both directions when d is retained; forgetting d after modulus minimization can identify distinct refinement presentations
inverse_status: two-sided inverse after the explicitly typed branchwise reduction; the literal common-denominator triple is the scale (d/c_i)*(a_i,b_i,c_i)
exceptions: constant rcwa branches a_i=0 lie outside Matthews's nonzero-multiplier class
d=1 lies outside the admitted d-adic Matthews scope
no modulus minimization or silent normalization is performed

name: Urata_odd_unit_exponent_conjugacy
domain: X=Z_2^times minus union_{j>=0} phi^{-j}({-1/3}), under the accelerated odd-unit map phi
codomain: (Z_{>=1})^N_0 under the one-sided left shift
well_definedness: the inverse series converges because S_{j-1}>=j-1; suffix points are units and satisfy 3x_k+1=2^(p_{k+1})x_{k+1}, so all valuations are exact and the singular point is avoided
preserved_structure: accelerated dynamics, all finite exponent prefixes, the variable 2-adic cylinder balls of modulus 2^(S_n+1), topology, and normalized Haar measure after deleting a null exceptional tree
fibres: singletons; the source odd-map fibre before coding is the countable labelled family F_p(y)=(2^p y-1)/3
inverse_status: explicit two-sided inverse series; finite inverse branches compose as F_w(y)=(2^(S_n)y-C_n)/3^n
exceptions: the domain excludes every accelerated preimage of -1/3
the realization is 2-adic and does not imply positive-integer surjectivity
the official Proposition 4 Cauchy estimate is replaced by a separately attributed constructive proof

name: Urata_accelerated_to_binary_first_return_bridge
domain: X under phi with positive exponent coordinates E_U
codomain: binary parity sequences beginning with one and containing infinitely many ones, under variable powers of the binary shift
formula: P_2(x)=B(E_U(x)); phi^j(x)=T^(S_j)(x); B(shift p)=shift^(p_1)(B(p))
well_definedness: each p_j is positive, so B gives the block 1 followed by p_j-1 zeros and all partial return times S_j are finite and strictly increasing
preserved_structure: chronological parity itinerary, order of odd returns, exact elapsed shortened times, and least periodic-word length after run expansion
fibres: singletons because both E_U and B are bijections on their typed domains
inverse_status: successive one-position gaps recover E_U, then the explicit Urata inverse series recovers x
exceptions: this is an induced variable-time bridge, not equality of phi with one fixed iterate of T
binary words with finitely many ones are excluded and correspond to the singular preimage tree
no positive-integer realization follows

name: scalar_Siegel_Hydra_to_retained_modulus_Matthews_presentation
domain: scalar selected-branch-admissible Hydra presentations on Z with retained ideal D*Z and branches H_i(n)=a_i*n+b_i
codomain: Matthews presentations at the same retained D with integer data (m_i,s_i) satisfying s_i congruent to i*m_i modulo D
formula: forward m_i=D*a_i and s_i=-D*b_i; inverse H_i(n)=(m_i*n-s_i)/D
well_definedness: admissibility at i and i+D makes D*a_i and D*b_i integral and evaluation at i gives the congruence; the congruence makes the inverse branch integer-valued on i+D*Z
preserved_structure: the retained modulus D, every labelled branch as a rational-affine map, the selected piecewise map Z->Z, and the complete branch integrality locus i+(D/gcd(m_i,D))*Z
fibres: singletons in both directions while D and branch labels are retained
inverse_status: literal two-sided inverse at the retained presentation modulus
exceptions: only scalar branches over Q are in the domain; genuinely non-scalar F-linear Hydras are excluded
no modulus minimization or coefficient normalization is performed
exact integrality corresponds to gcd(m_i,D)=1 and is not global integrality of every branch extension
passage to reduced rcwa data uses MOR-COL-000007 separately

name: Siegel_finite_word_affine_cocycle
domain: finite labelled branch words Sigma_Lambda^* under concatenation
codomain: the affine group Aff_F(K), represented as End_F^x(K) semidirect K under affine composition
formula: w=(j_1,...,j_N) maps to H_w=H_(j_1) o ... o H_(j_N)=(M_w,X_w); (M_(i wedge j),X_(i wedge j))=(M_i o M_j,M_i(X_j)+X_i)
well_definedness: finite composition of invertible affine F-linear maps is an invertible affine F-linear map; induction gives the unique multiplier and translation coefficients
preserved_structure: concatenation order, affine composition, noncommutative multiplier order, the translation cocycle, empty-word identity, and the least-significant-digit-first convention
fibres: unclassified; distinct words can determine the same affine map, multiplier, or numen value
inverse_status: no inverse asserted
exceptions: the rightmost branch acts first on a state
the word is an address, not automatically the actual itinerary of a point
no scalar multiplication convention is imposed on r_j

name: Siegel_centered_numen_DigSum_factorization
domain: Sigma_p^*/~ where words are equivalent exactly when their least-significant-first DigSum values agree
codomain: K via the centered finite numen
formula: [w] maps to X_w, and under Sigma_p^*/~ isomorphic to N_0 the values obey X(p*n+j)=r_j(X(n))+c_j
well_definedness: each DigSum fibre consists of the canonical finite digit word and its terminal-zero extensions; centeredness c_0=0 makes H_0(0)=0, so terminal zeros do not change X_w
preserved_structure: finite digit recursion, canonical nonnegative-integer coordinates, and the retained enumeration of O_K/Lambda
fibres: raw DigSum fibres are exactly terminal-zero variants; fibres of the descended numen in K are unclassified
inverse_status: no inverse asserted
exceptions: M_w does not descend because M_(w wedge 0)=M_w o r_0 in general
no p-adic continuation, injectivity, fibre theorem, or conjugacy follows
uncentered functional-equation solutions use an independently specified initial value

name: Laarhoven_de_Weger_projective_finite_parity_graph_isomorphism
domain: the projective family of finite directed relations C(k)=(V_k,E_k) with V_k=Z/2^k Z and endpoint-reduction maps
codomain: the projective family of binary De Bruijn relations B(2,k) with suffix edges and endpoint-reduction maps
formula: Qbar_(3,k)([a])=sum_(i<k)(T^i(a) mod 2)2^i; Qbar_(3,k)[T_k(a)]=sigma_(2,k)(Qbar_(3,k)(a)); rho_(k+1,k) o Qbar_(3,k+1)=Qbar_(3,k) o rho_(k+1,k)
well_definedness: the first k chronological parities depend exactly on a modulo 2^k; Lagarias 1985 Theorem B and Bernstein 1994 independently identify the finite permutation, while Bernstein-Lagarias Q_3 preserves every 2-adic congruence distance; set brackets denote elementwise images of successor subsets
preserved_structure: vertices, directed edges, endpoint reduction, exact directed-path multiplicities, digit-prefix distances, and the inverse-limit dynamics
fibres: singletons at every finite level; the inverse-limit fibre is also a singleton
inverse_status: at level k the inverse is the reduction of Bernstein-Lagarias Phi_3=Q_3^(-1); the inverse-limit map is Q_3 with inverse Phi_3
exceptions: finite T_k and sigma_(2,k) are two-successor relations rather than point maps
successors of one fixed higher vertex reduce to one lower successor, although the full edge projection is surjective
the graph isomorphism does not characterize the embedded positive integers or prove an endpoint
cycles of the finite labeling permutation are not cycles of the modular Collatz relation

name: primitive_rational_T_cycle_to_3n_plus_b_integer_cycle
domain: cyclically indexed rational periodic T-orbits in Z_2 intersect Q, modulo cyclic phase
codomain: common-odd-scaling classes of pairs (b,(n_j)) where b>0 is odd and (n_j) is an integer T^(3,b)-cycle, modulo the same cyclic phase
formula: choose a common odd denominator b and set n_j=b*x_j; inverse sends (b,(n_j)) to x_j=n_j/b; (b,(n_j)) is identified with (c*b,(c*n_j)) for odd positive c
well_definedness: odd multiplication preserves 2-adic parity, and branchwise b*T(x)=T^(3,b)(b*x); changing the common denominator by odd scaling does not change the rational tuple; the primitive denominator divides 2^L-3^m, and is coprime to 3 because m>=1 makes that integer a unit modulo 3 while m=0 forces the zero cycle and denominator 1
preserved_structure: cyclic order, displayed return length, least period, every parity phase, and each branch equation
fibres: a raw rational cycle has all of its common odd scalings as representatives; after quotienting the fibre is a singleton, equivalently represented by gcd(b,n_0,...,n_(L-1))=1
inverse_status: division by b is a literal two-sided inverse on scaling classes; primitive positive-denominator representatives are unique
exceptions: without the scaling quotient the correspondence is not injective
the cycles {b,2b} for odd b all map to the rational cycle {1,2}
a nonprimitive raw representative may have b divisible by 3 even though the unique primitive denominator cannot
the morphism does not classify which primitive parameters yield positive integer cycles
Lagarias 1990 explicitly retains the raw gcd strata and primitive reduced-denominator layer

name: Crandall_finite_height_backward_address_bijection
domain: the finite exponent addresses (a_1,...,a_j) with a_1>2, mod-3 integrality at every index, and nonterminal continuation gates mod 9
codomain: positive odd integers m>1 whose Crandall accelerated trajectory first reaches 1 after finitely many steps

name: integer_state_to_parity_label_graph_bijection_and_branch_evaluator_factorization
domain: The additive group Z, carrying the shortened Collatz branch evaluator H as additional displayed data.

well_definedness: iota(n) lies in Delta. On D the second coordinate b equals n mod 2, so F_v(n) is integral. Direct substitution gives H on both parity fibres.
preserved_structure: eta retains the integer state exactly and appends its unique admissible coefficient label. iota is a surjective group homomorphism Z->Delta with kernel 2Z; eta preserves equality and the complete state coordinate.

No orbit, period, density, or endpoint theorem follows from the label graph alone.

name: four_label_affine_set_embedding

The certificate finds zero composition equalities lambda(v) o lambda(w)=lambda(v+w) among all sixteen ordered pairs.

name: odd_first_return_to_legal_local_block_category_isomorphism

name: positive_exponent_word_to_prefix_semidirect_product_injection

The target is a monoid, not a group: theta is noninvertible for positive length.
In coordinates (m,A) the multiplier is 3^m2^(-A).
For standard target-left path multiplication this coefficient target must be opposited.

name: finite_residue_transformation_semigroup_reduction

Reduction does not define a faithful finite quotient of the object-typed path category.

name: inverse_limit_affine_coefficient_classification_bijection

exceptions: The codomain is not all affine maps with slope in 3Z_3; valuation-one slopes must equal 3b.
Constants occur as limit points although no finite word has zero 3-adic slope.
The countable actual exponent-generated semigroup is not identified with the all-unit semigroup; only their closures are equal.

Object reduction modulo 3^N alone is not a categorical congruence.
The representation proves no orbit endpoint.

A finite residue action has further word collisions beyond these source fibres.

The opposite monoid is forced by target-left category multiplication.
The faithful target retains infinitely many object and decorated-word coordinates and is not finite-dimensional.
